name: Pozuelo de Alarcón (Spain)
description: Purple field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pozuelo de Alarcón (a castle on yellow and a cross on red).
history: The flag of Pozuelo de Alarcón, approved on 18 October 1991 and published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 19 November 1991, is of proportion 2:3, purple, with the municipal arms in its colours over all at the centre.

features.role: Pozuelo de Alarcón arms — castle on yellow and cross on red
yellow field and crown of the arms
